evals.prompt: /mission build a fashion and outfit creating iOS app. Cloudflare backend, native Swift iOS frontend. Users photograph their clothes and get outfit suggestions.
evals.expected_output: Intake produces a PROFILE with primary shape GRN, class XL, traits multi_platform, has_ios, has_backend_api, touches_pii, has_ai_llm_features (or unknown with a forking question), design_quality_matters; ≤3 multiple-choice forking questions with defaults; a plan whose first milestones are M0 contract freeze and M1 walking skeleton deployed to dev before any feature fan-out.
assertions: Primary shape is GRN and class is XL, with the four class scores recorded
At most 3 questions are asked, each multiple choice with a recommended default
M0 is a frozen API contract with contract tests on both backend and iOS sides
M1 is a walking skeleton exercising real Worker bindings end to end, not only a health endpoint
The plan includes XCUITest journeys, a screenshot matrix with Dynamic Type and dark mode, and performAccessibilityAudit
Personal photo storage triggers retention/deletion requirements and in-app account deletion if accounts exist
Every model reference uses full IDs claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-4-8 or claude-sonnet-4-6; Haiku is never used

evals.prompt: /mission the checkout e2e test fails about 1 in 50 runs in CI. Find the root cause and fix it.
evals.expected_output: BUG shape; failure record before code changes; REPRODUCED gate with measured baseline rate; bisect/differential before theorizing; hypothesis ledger; two-way intervention confirmed by a separate agent; proof by n ≥ ln(0.05)/ln(1−0.02) ≈ 149 consecutive clean runs (doubled if state cannot be reset); sibling sweep; conversion into regression test + control + lesson candidate.
assertions: No fix is attempted before a repro script fails at a recorded rate
Retries, timeout bumps or skipping the test are rejected as fixes unless the confirmed cause is an external transient
The flaky-fix proof uses the ln(α)/ln(1−p) formula, not 'passed a few times'
The root cause is confirmed by an agent other than the investigator
The retro converts the failure into a regression test plus at least one mechanical control or generic audit task

evals.prompt: /mission add a usage analytics dashboard to our existing admin app (React + Cloudflare Worker API).
evals.expected_output: FEA shape, class M; conventions digest before design; mini spec with metric definitions (source, formula, timezone, refresh, empty/partial); spine lane then ≤4 widget lanes; journeys asserting displayed aggregates against seeded data; negative authz test; G1–G3 visual gates.
assertions: A conventions digest (CONTEXT.md) is produced before design and existing components are reused
Each metric has a definition requirement including timezone and empty-state semantics
E2E journeys assert aggregate numbers against seeded data, not merely that charts render
Visual verification runs deterministic checks before the vision verifier and the vision verifier is a separate agent

evals.prompt: /mission move our AI gateway from the external ai-gateway repo into a core service of our platform monorepo.
evals.expected_output: MIG shape, class L (XL if external customers call it); feasibility report; parity inventory captured from the old gateway before the move; validated parity judge with oracle-bite; no behaviour changes until parity; shadow parity before cutover; per-consumer cutover with human approval and rollback; old path retired or kept by decision.
assertions: Parity baseline is captured from the old system before any code moves
Behaviour changes are deferred to a post-parity milestone
Cutover steps require human approval and each has a rollback step
Moving API keys or secrets triggers a security review lens on Opus 4.8

evals.prompt: /mission research our market position and create a website describing the project, goals and team, with blog and documentation sections.
evals.expected_output: WEB primary with RSR first; question cards; angle research lanes plus skeptic; positioning before messaging; every factual claim bound to a source ID; [NEEDS-EVIDENCE] instead of invented stats, testimonials or team details; build, link check, Lighthouse, visual gates; publish is a human checkpoint.
assertions: Research runs before sitemap or copy, and positioning precedes messaging
No statistic, testimonial or team detail is invented; missing evidence is marked [NEEDS-EVIDENCE] and blocks launch
A fact-checker agent distinct from the researchers verifies public claims
Publishing to production waits for human approval

evals.prompt: /mission fix the typo in the README heading and the broken link to CONTRIBUTING.md
evals.expected_output: Class S; no .mission directory, charter, swarm or review panel; one quick check (link check) and a single verification pass; the whole thing stays cheap.
assertions: No charter, spec, swarm or multi-round review is created
Fable 5.1 is not used for the work
The fix is verified by running a link check or equivalent command, with the output cited

evals.prompt: /mission autonomous: upgrade the app from Vite 5 to Vite 7 overnight
evals.expected_output: UPG shape in autonomous mode; parity baseline on the old version; one major at a time; no blocking questions (defaults logged as ASSUMED); no deploys or merges; ends in a draft PR; hard budget cap; STATUS and HANDOFF written.
assertions: No question blocks progress; assumptions are logged as ASSUMED (unconfirmed)
Nothing is merged to the default branch or deployed; work ends in a draft PR on a claude/ branch
A hard budget cap is set for the headless run
The existing test suite is green on the old version before the upgrade starts

evals.prompt: Review round 4 on the auth service found 12 new minor issues and no blockers. Should we run round 5?
evals.expected_output: No: the surface closes when a round yields no CONFIRMED blocker or major; minors are dispositioned and never trigger another round; round caps by class apply.
assertions: The answer closes the review surface instead of commissioning round 5
Minor findings get dispositions (FIXED, RESIDUAL, DEFERRED) rather than another full round
